lines.say: Five facts about sharks that sound made up.
lines.caption: 5 facts
lines.cap: Five facts about sharks that sound made up.

lines.say: One. Sharks are older than trees. They've been around for more than four hundred million years.
lines.caption: Older than trees
lines.cap: One. Sharks are older than trees. They've been around for more than 400 million years.

lines.say: Two. They have no bones. Their skeleton is cartilage, the same stuff as your nose and ears.
lines.caption: No bones
lines.cap: Two. They have no bones. Their skeleton is cartilage, the same stuff as your nose and ears.

lines.say: Three. They never run out of teeth. Lost teeth are replaced again and again, thousands in a lifetime.
lines.caption: Teeth
lines.cap: Three. They never run out of teeth. Lost teeth are replaced again and again, thousands in a lifetime.

lines.say: Four. They can sense electricity. Tiny pores on the snout pick up the faint signals of a hidden fish's muscles.
lines.caption: Electric sense
lines.cap: Four. They can sense electricity. Tiny pores on the snout pick up the faint signals of a hidden fish's muscles.

lines.say: Five. The Greenland shark can live at least two hundred and seventy years, maybe close to four hundred.
lines.caption: Greenland shark
lines.cap: Five. The Greenland shark can live at least 270 years, maybe close to 400.
